title: Official OGC WMS 1.3.0 capabilities and exception schema validation

source.description: Exact checksum-pinned WMS 1.3.0 schemas from the official OGC repository plus their W3C XLink/XML imports.

expectedOutcomes.assertion: Generated WMS_Capabilities and ServiceExceptionReport documents validate against exact official OGC 1.3.0 schemas with all imports resolved locally after checksum verification.
The verifier rejects deliberately invalid version documents, proving the schema gate is active rather than a well-formedness-only check.
